metadata.title: Virginia eVA Supplier Directory Snapshot 2026-10-31 (Ledger Lab Research Archive)
metadata.description:
A dated snapshot of the Virginia eVA public supplier directory, captured 2026-10-31. Source: logi.cgieva.com/External/rdPage.aspx (Report9001_Data public report).

Files in this record (Zenodo stores files without folders; a double underscore stands for a folder separator):

  • suppliers.csv — 230,128 canonical supplier/location observations with rich HTML fields and source provenance. Includes eVA supplier ID (not a DUNS or Cardinal vendor ID), supplier name, location name, address, registration type (Self/State), active status from HTML (Active=230,068; Pending Approval=60), SWaM classifications, and payment capability flags. Two records have missing supplier IDs and are retained with quality flags.
  • audit.json — integrity audit: 230,128 observations, 230,126 nonblank IDs, 2,912 retained source pages, data_integrity_verified=true.
  • manifest.json — acquisition scope, counts, completion basis, checksums.
  • source_export__suppliers_source.csv — unchanged full source CSV export (UTF-8 BOM, 230,128 rows). The column named “Status” in this file holds Self/State registration type, not Active/Pending status.
  • source_export__manifest.json — exact request, headers, encoding, SHA-256.
  • source_export__reconciliation.json — complete field coverage reconciliation.
  • historical_candidate_details__historical_candidate_vlin_verification.csv — 22 VLIN verification rows covering 21 distinct legacy vendor IDs from historical purchase orders: 20 rows agree with the current directory and 2 are unresolved.

Import supplier IDs and postal codes as strings. This snapshot covers the public main-directory report only; it does not cover the separate inactive directory or every Commonwealth payee. Current directory observations do not establish historical FY2003–FY2016 identities.

Acquisition interval: 2026-11-01T00:34–01:56 UTC. Not an atomic source-system snapshot.

Part of the Virginia corpus for The Architecture of Economic State (Twitchell). Related to the eVA procurement record (10.5281/zenodo.23846362). This snapshot is a reference file and is not an input to the corpus restore script.

Released government data, public domain. No license was provided by the source; public-domain status is asserted by the depositor and is not a legal finding.
